title: The Grammatical Calculus
summary: We give an introduction to the grammatical calculus, which originated from the umbral calculus of Rota. Context-free grammars arise in computer science. Differential operators can be viewed as the production rules of context-free grammars. By the properties of differential operators, we may perform the grammatical calculus on a rigorous basis, for the purposes of deriving combinatorial identities and computing generating functions.
